description:
Roon 20'' Kids Fat Tire Bike

Wide Tire - Adapts to a variety of terrains for a smooth and easy ride.
Dual Disc Brakes - Fully ensure your child's safety.

Shimano Drivetrain & Revoshift Shifter - Easy handling, which helps children and beginners learn the gears easily.

Durable and Comfortable

Hiland frames are made from hi-ten steel with strong support strength, allows for bumping absorption and a smooth ride on mountain roads, forest paths and snowfield.

Ergonomic and adjustable seat makes the trip easier. Soft seat and sturdy frame can adapt to various road, has a good shock absorption effect, effectively resists the impact on the body.

Wide Tire

The 20*4.0-inch tires run with very low air pressure, make for a great ride experience on mountain roads, highways, and forest ways.

It provide upgraded grip and traction on rough roads. These fat tires keep you safe and give you a smooth and easy ride even in the most challenging terrain and weather conditions.

Double Disc Double Safe

Disc brakes allow for more precise and controlled , are more effective than rim brakes, help to keep safer when riding at high speeds, down slopes and in wet conditions.

Hiland kids fat tire bikes feature a dual mechanical disc, which ensure that the child can stop immediately in case of emergency.

Professional Drivetrain

SHIMANO TY300D rear derailleur and MICROSHIFT MS25 grip shifter to ease kids into how to use gears.

It provide 7 speed gears for your little ones to make it up and down almost anything.

Assembly & Guide

85% pre-assembled, assembly tools included, easy to assemble within 25 minutes. Click on the video to see an instructional video on assembly.

Solutions will be quickly provided by support team within 24 hours! Bikes all have been inspected before package. Solve all your worries!

4.0" Fat Tire

4.0" fat tire can ride on almost any kinds of rough terrains and dirt trails, offering comfortable and stable riding experience.

Hi-Ten Steel Frame

Hiland frames are made from high carbon steel with strong support strength.

Dual Disc Brake

Features a dual mechanica disc, which ensure that the child can stop immediately in case of emergency.

Shimano 7-Speed Drivetrain

Professional Shimano 7-speed drivetrain with twist shifter makes gear changes smoother and also is easy for kids to handle.

Conquer any terrain with the Hiland Roon Fat Tire Bike. Featuring 4-inch wide tires, a Shimano 7-speed drivetrain, and dual disc brakes, this mountain bike is built for snow, sand, and mud.
